controls.name: Load
controls.note: any setParameter value (1 or 0) triggers; loads slot Prog#

controls.name: Save
controls.note: any setParameter value (1 or 0) triggers; saves params to slot Prog#

controls.name: Status
controls.note: visual-only LED: 1 for ~500ms after Load/Save, then 0; host writes ignored

controls.name: Clip
controls.note: visual-only clip LED: 1 while the output clips, then 0 after ~150ms; host writes ignored
